S/2019/190.outcome: not adopted, too few affirmative votes

numbered_evidence.first_vote: On 28 February 2019 the United States submitted S/2019/186. It received nine votes in favour, three against and three abstentions. China and the Russian Federation voted against it as permanent members, and the draft was not adopted.
numbered_evidence.second_vote: S/2019/190 was a separate Russian draft. It received four votes in favour, seven against and four abstentions and failed to reach the required number of affirmative votes.
numbered_evidence.presidency: Equatorial Guinea held the Council presidency and its representative announced both results. Equatorial Guinea abstained on S/2019/186 and voted in favour of S/2019/190.
numbered_evidence.indonesia: Indonesia abstained on both votes. It urged inclusive political dialogue and called on the parties to accept the Secretary-General's good offices. The supplied statement records no Indonesian allocation of aid money.

guard_pairs.bounded: S/2019/186 received nine affirmative votes, but it did not take effect because two permanent members voted against it.
guard_pairs.foil: S/2019/186 took effect after receiving nine affirmative votes, despite the two permanent members voting against it.

guard_pairs.bounded: The Council put S/2019/190 to a separate vote. The draft fell short of the affirmative votes needed to adopt it.
guard_pairs.foil: The Council put S/2019/190 to a separate vote. The draft reached the necessary affirmative votes and took effect.

guard_pairs.bounded: Equatorial Guinea's representative announced the disposition as Council President. The country itself abstained on the first draft.
guard_pairs.foil: Equatorial Guinea's representative announced the disposition as Council President. The country itself voted in favour of the first draft.

guard_pairs.bounded: Indonesia urged an inclusive political dialogue and asked the parties to accept the Secretary-General's good offices.
guard_pairs.foil: Indonesia urged an inclusive political dialogue and committed to finance a new United Nations aid programme.
